implementation: candidate-limited single-phase PXRD router and fixed-prototype lattice refinement

A_inventory_and_provenance.details: Three COD CIFs are present, parsed and SHA-256 pinned. NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib are available. The optional UI dependencies were installed only in the ignored worktree venv; no frozen classifier weights or PyTorch are available.

B_headless_physics_and_refinement.details: All three CIFs use one general renderer and bounded lattice/zero-shift/width/scale/background fitting. Synthetic end-to-end tests identify and recover each generated candidate.

C_optional_frozen_classifier.details: Graceful unavailable adapter is implemented. No checkpoint or PyTorch exists in this worktree/environment, so no inference or soft-prior run was possible. The route always scores every candidate.

D_streamlit_uploader_and_plot.details: Streamlit uploader and measured-versus-fit/residual plot are implemented. The app launched headlessly from the ignored worktree venv and /_stcore/health returned ok.

E_tests_demo_docs_and_delivery.details: Eight unittest cases passed; deterministic SIMULATED demos were run for all three CIFs. No real measured data were available. Commit, push, and Draft PR attempt remain pending.

limitations: no measured-spectrum accuracy or confidence-calibration claim
not universal phase or chemical-composition identification
three-candidate single-phase CIF hypothesis set only
f(s)=Z neutral-atom approximation, Gaussian peaks, no instrument or preferred-orientation model
